'''Pierre Dubreuil''' (GEMP handle '''bringhim''')<ref name="ocs-71634">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=71634 2019 Season Passholder List- 82], 2019 Online Championship Series, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 January 2019). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2019_OCS_Season_Passholder_List_82_forum_t71634 Internet Archive]. [[:File:SWCCG forum t71634 2019 OCS Season Passholder List.txt]]</ref> lost in the round of 64 at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]], where he was seeded 56.<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>

He won the four-player [[2008 Canadian Nationals]] on 2 August 2008, 12 (+154), with DBO and Endor Ops; he and his son [[Philippe Dubreuil]] took its two Day 2 automatic bids for the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22727-329509">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=329509#p329509 Official Results - Canada Nationnals], trooper shark, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 August 2008).</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>
